# crosswork_l2vpn_id_pools (Data Source)

This data source can read the association of the L2VPN with resource pools.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_l2vpn_id_pools" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `evi_id_pool` (String) Pool of the automatic EVI ids (`auto_evi_id` of a service)
- `evi_source_target_pool` (String) Pool of the automatic EVI source and target (`auto_evi_source` and `auto_evi_target` of a service)
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `rt_pool` (String) Pool of the automatic route targets
